'''May 2000 Cookeville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Cookeville, Tennessee on 13 May 2000. [[Michael Crosby]] won it. It is known from Mike Wudhapitak's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d773">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-cookeville-tennessee-5-13-00d773/ cookeville-tennessee-5-13-00], DeckTech (Mike "Anime Knight" Wudhapitak, 21 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-cookeville-tennessee-5-13-00d773/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Cookeville, Tennessee
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Crosby]]
